info.title: Matchbox API
info.description: Read Mezo Earn market data and Matchbox gauge profiles: every gauge across the four voters, per-epoch incentives with USD values and APRs, epoch timing, and curated profiles for boost and validator gauges. Market data is a snapshot refreshed about every 5 minutes. Generated from `@repo/platform-contracts`.

get.description:
Gauges with at least one non-zero reward for the epoch: voting incentives (`bribe`) and pool trading fees (`fees`), in token base units.

`usd` is `null` for tokens without a registry price; `totalUsd` sums the priced rewards and `unpricedRewards` counts the rest.

`aprPercent` annualizes `totalUsd` against the gauge's voting power valued at the voting token's price (MEZO for veMEZO voters, BTC for veBTC voters): `totalUsd * 52 / (weight / 1e18 * votingTokenUsd) * 100`. It is `null` with no priced rewards, no weight or no voting-token price.

Data is a snapshot refreshed about every 5 minutes; see `meta.asOf` and `meta.blockNumber`.

parameters.name: network
parameters.description: `mezo` or `mezo-testnet`; every key reads both.

parameters.name: epoch
parameters.description: `current` (the newest snapshot up to now; see `meta.epoch`), `next`, or an epoch start in unix seconds (a multiple of 604800).

parameters.name: gauge
parameters.description: Gauge addresses (repeatable or comma-separated, up to 50).

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: `ETag` from a previous response; returns 304 when unchanged.

bearerAuth.description:
Send `Authorization: Bearer <key>`.

- **Publishable keys** (`mbx_pk_test_…`, `mbx_pk_live_…`) are safe in browsers. The request `Origin` must be registered on the key's environment.
- **Secret keys** (`mbx_sk_test_…`, `mbx_sk_live_…`) are server-only. Requests carrying an `Origin` header are rejected; an optional CIDR allowlist applies.

Test and live keys both read `mezo` and `mezo-testnet`. Live keys require an approved environment and get higher rate limits. Revocation takes effect within 15 seconds.

voteStart.description: Votes open one hour into the epoch.

voteEnd.description: Votes close one hour before the epoch ends.

Epoch.description: A Mezo Earn epoch in unix seconds: one week from Thursday 00:00 UTC, the same on every network.

VoterKind.description: The four Mezo Earn voters. `boost` and `third-party` count veMEZO voting power; `pools` and `validators` count veBTC voting power.

weight.description: Voting power on this gauge in base units (18 decimals); `null` if unread.

vebtcTokenId.description: The veBTC lock this gauge boosts.

beneficiary.description: Receives the gauge's emissions (the veBTC owner at creation).

weight.description: Voting power on this gauge in base units (18 decimals); `null` if unread.
Voting power on this gauge in base units (18 decimals); `null` if unread.
Voting power on this gauge in base units (18 decimals); `null` if unread.

RewardKind.description: `bribe` = voting incentives; `fees` = pool trading fees (pools only).

usd.description: USD value of `amount`; `null` when the token has no registry price.

weight.description: Voting power on this gauge in base units (18 decimals); `null` if unread.

totalUsd.description: Sum of priced rewards; `null` when none is priced.

unpricedRewards.description: Rewards left out of `totalUsd` because their token has no price.

aprPercent.description: Annualizes `totalUsd` against the gauge's voting power valued at the voting token's price (MEZO for veMEZO voters, BTC for veBTC voters): `totalUsd * 52 / (weight / 1e18 * votingTokenUsd) * 100`. `null` with no priced rewards, no weight or no voting-token price.

GaugeIncentives.description: One gauge's rewards for one epoch.

PriceSource.description: `skip-oracle`: Skip Connect BTC/USD oracle on Mezo. `aerodrome-cl`: Aerodrome Slipstream MEZO/MUSD pool on Base. `stablecoin`: registry stablecoin at $1. `btc-pegged`: registry BTC-pegged token at the BTC price. `mezo`: the MEZO token at the MEZO price.

blockNumber.description: Mezo block the snapshot was read at.

MarketMeta.description: Where and when the data was read. Market data is a snapshot refreshed about every 5 minutes, not live.

GaugeEpoch.description: One epoch of a gauge's history, as last snapshotted in that epoch.
